name: Yuda
source:
A nun living in room 201 of the Hisekisou apartment complex. She is the homeroom teacher of the protagonist's class. She teaches music but is also in charge of student guidance. She is an extremely useless adult. She always oversleeps, she tells weird proverbs to the protagonist and the heroines, and she tells dirty jokes. During events at the church she plays the pipe organ. 

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/初恋サクラメント]Wikipedia[/url]]
